answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 46 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in falcon, verified in reef, and pearl names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That bill is paid per identity, so 204 aliases cost 282 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
